verdict.rationale: Asana documents a full RESTful API with a published OpenAPI spec, official JavaScript/Python SDKs, webhooks and an official MCP server for creating and managing tasks, projects and AI Teammates. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, so the API's breadth relative to the UI is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit documented claim of UI-to-API parity, evidence covering UI features such as rules/automations, AI Studio, dashboards and admin settings via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON or form-encoded requests, returns JSON
